name: build123d
role: Python parametric CAD for precise product geometry and SVG technical projections
summary: Python parametric CAD on Open Cascade: scripts construct precise solids using builder contexts or algebraic operations, then export STEP, STL, glTF/GLB or SVG projections. Useful upstream of product visualisation when dimensions, fillets, booleans and reproducible variants matter.
use_when: Create dimensioned product parts for a later Blender or Three.js scene
Generate SVG technical projections or cross sections from the same CAD source
Prefer exact solid operations over editing a triangular mesh in Trimesh
avoid_when: Need lighting, materials, camera animation and final frames: Blender or Three.js
Need analysis or repair of existing triangular meshes: Trimesh
Need typography or freeform vector artwork: SVG or Inkscape
license: Apache-2.0 for project code; Open Cascade bindings, other dependencies and supplied assets have separate terms

install.check_command: .venv/bin/python -c "import build123d; from importlib.metadata import version; print(version('build123d'))"
